Integrate subsystems (libraries or processes) into one main system and manage their dependencies
Implement concurrency control so the integrated system yields reproducible results
Debug and trace issues across integrated components
Profile the system, locate bottlenecks, and deliver optimizations
Port the system to different platforms
(Optional) Modify MCU or embedded Linux firmware to help the fusion system operate smoothly
(Optional) Improve fusion accuracy by analyzing results, tuning parameters, or applying alternative theories

description.text:
About the Role
In this role, you will work on the core software platform for sensor-driven systems used in unmanned vehicles. You will be responsible for designing and integrating a robust, modular system architecture that brings together multiple software components and sensors into a reliable system.
You will collaborate closely with engineers across AI, computer vision, and platform teams to ensure smooth integration, predictable system behavior, and high-performance execution on onboard and edge computing platforms. Your work will focus on building scalable and maintainable system foundations that support a wide range of applications, including — but not limited to — drone-based products, while remaining adaptable to other autonomous or robotic platforms.
Responsibilities
* Design and maintain a modular system architecture for sensor-driven perception and fusion systems used in unmanned and mobile platforms
* Integrate subsystems (libraries or processes) into one main system and manage their dependencies
* Implement concurrency control so the integrated system yields reproducible results
* Debug and trace issues across integrated components
* Profile the system, locate bottlenecks, and deliver optimizations
* Port the system to different platforms
* (Optional) Modify MCU or embedded Linux firmware to help the fusion system operate smoothly
* (Optional) Improve fusion accuracy by analyzing results, tuning parameters, or applying alternative theories

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Required Skills:
* Modern C++
* CMake
* Git
Required Experience:
* Designing a clean system architecture and performing the system integration
* Multithreaded programming
* Proficiency in the C++ STL and fundamental data structures & algorithms
* Cross-platform development
* Practical debugging and troubleshooting
* Managing Git submodules
Preferred Experience (any of the following is a plus):
* MATLAB, Python, or Bash scripting for prototyping, automation, or data analysis
* Sensor-fusion algorithms
* Firmware development
* Capturing images from cameras on Linux using V4L2, GStreamer, or FFmpeg
* Experience working with robotics, drones, or autonomous systems is a strong plus
